blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Contour Ploughing involves ploughing along slope contours to effectively reduce runoff.
Terracing prevents erosion by creating steps on steep slopes.
Afforestation focuses on planting trees to securely bind the soil.
Strip Cropping minimizes soil erosion by alternating strips of different crops.
Shelter Belts reduce wind speed through strategically planted rows of trees.

blocks.content: Afforestation: Planting trees to bind soil.

items: Distinguish between Shelter Belts (reduces wind speed) and Afforestation (binds soil using trees).
Contour Ploughing and Terracing are both slope-based techniques, but Terracing specifically involves creating steps.
Strip Cropping relies on alternating crop layouts to combat soil erosion.
